Title: Is a locquipment a location while not in play

Messages.Author: the1andonlime
Messages.Body:
There is an existing ruling that says locquipments are not locations while in hand, ash heap, or library
groups.google.com/g/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/c/aMum-K7LEeo/m/94iN92zwYTcJ

However, it was pointed out (and a fantastic point at that) that:
1. Delivery Truck specifically talks about non-location equipment but critically does not put it into play, thus contradicting the ruling, and
2. the latest printing of Living Manse updates the locquipment template to now have the "Location" trait, meaning it definitely is a location in all zones

Putting aside Delivery Truck, this new templating (great work btw) means the ruling no longer holds true for all locquipments

Can we get an official general ruling on the "location" state of locquipments for clarity and for the record?

Suaku

Delivery truck follows the golden rule for cards like all cards do. You cannot choose a location card with because just as concealed weapon knows what cardtext does even when cardtext has no effect while in hand (aggravated damage), so does Delivery Truck know whether or not Palatial estate is a location. Or any other Loquipment.

> The Golden Rule for Cards: Whenever the cards contradict the rules, the cards take precedence.
>
www.vekn.net/rulebook

So Delivery Truck follows the golden rule as everything does, it will know what is location and what is not. Hence to attempt putting Location out of play with it is attempting something you cannot do, which at that point why not just attempt to steal five more pool from the blood bank. Or attempt to change the card that's on Delivery truck with a card that's in your left pocket. Or attempt to claim there's a ruling that allows attempting things that cannot be done?

So unless Ankha decides to start tossing REVERSALS here, they stay as they are.

Name: Delivery Truck [Anarchs:R, KoT:R] Cardtype: Equipment Vehicle. During your master phase, you may show a non-location equipment card from your hand to the other players and place it face down on the Delivery Truck if it doesn't already have one. You may look at the card at any time. Any minion you control may equip that card (face up) as a +1 stealth action (requirements and cost apply as normal). A minion may have only one vehicle. Artist: Jeff Holt

Name: Concealed Weapon [Jyhad:C, CE:C/PB/PTo, BH:PTo4, KMW:PAl3, LotN:PG2, KoT:C/PT2] Cardtype: Combat Only usable before range is determined. This minion equips with a non-unique weapon card from your hand (requirements and cost apply as normal). The weapon cannot cost 3 or more pool or inflict (with a regular strike) aggravated damage or 4 or more damage. Artist: Alejandro Collucci; Jeff Menges

Name: Living Manse [Sabbat:R, SW:R, Third:R, SP:DoF1, POD:DTC, V5C:PTz1] Cardtype: Equipment Clan: Tzimisce Cost: 1 blood Location. While in play, this card does not count as equipment. This vampire gets +1 bleed. They can burn this card before range is determined to end combat. A vampire can have only one Living Manse. Artist: Mark Tedin

Messages.Author: the1andonlime
Messages.Body:
> I have no idea what is this latest printing about Living Manse that you're talking about, they've literally just bolded and reworded sabbat era text?
>
Living Manse, in the 2024 printing, went from "While in play, this equipment card represents a location and does not count as equipment" to "Location. While in play, this card does not count as equipment"

The 2022 ruling of the 2008 ruling now makes no sense for Living Manse as it is now, by card text, both a location and an equipment card (just like how Carfax Abbey is both a location and a master card)

As much as this is just "card text", I am hoping for a clarification from Ankha as to whether the plan is to reverse the ruling for equipments that count as locations while in play, or it will just be case by case depending on card text as they get updated
